title: Alexander Colón, Wichita Area Real Estate Agent
description: Straight answers about buying and selling in Wichita, Maize, Derby, Andover, Goddard, Park City, and Rose Hill. Ask a question before you commit to anything.
h1: Get real answers about buying or selling here before you commit to anything
job: Sort the visitor into the lane that fits them, and answer enough of their question that contacting Alex is the obvious next step.
primaryPrinciple: Reciprocity. The give comes before the ask.

bands.headline: Get real answers about buying or selling here before you commit to anything
bands.support: Alexander Colón is an agent with At Home Wichita Real Estate. He works with first time buyers, service members and veterans, people selling a house, and people buying property to rent out, across seven towns in the Wichita area.

bands.heading: Ask Wick a question first
bands.intro: Wick answers questions about buying and selling around Wichita. It says so when it does not know something, and it hands you to Alex the moment you would rather have a person.

lanes.line: You have not done this before and you want to know what it costs before anyone runs your credit.
You want a real number on your house and a straight read on whether now is the time.
You have a VA loan, a report date, or both, and the timeline is not something you control.
You want the rent, the carry, and what is left, worked on a specific address.

bands.heading: What working with Alex actually looks like
body: Most of what makes a purchase or a sale go badly is not drama, it is being asked to decide on something nobody explained to you first. Alex works the other way around. You get the explanation, then the decision is yours to make with the information in hand.
That holds from the first conversation through closing. He handles the parts that need handling and tells you about the parts that need you, and he does not disappear into email between them.

bands.heading: What waiting costs, worked on your numbers
body: A house you own while you are deciding is a house you are paying for. The mortgage payment, the taxes, the insurance, and the utilities you keep on all leave your account every month whether the house is listed or not.

Nobody can tell you what your house will sell for without seeing it, so this does not try. It only does the arithmetic on the money you are already spending while you think about it. Put your own figures in and see the number.

bands.heading: Who you would actually be working with
body: Alex works with first time buyers, service members and veterans, people selling a house, and people buying property to rent out. The thread running through all four is that they want to understand what is happening rather than be moved through it.
If you ask him a question you get the actual answer, including the times the answer is that you should wait, or that the house you are looking at is not worth what they are asking.
If what you want is someone who will agree with you, he is going to be a poor fit. He would rather you find that out on this page than three weeks into a transaction.

bands.heading: What people say about working with Alex
What happens if you contact him

items.q: Does contacting Alex sign me up for anything?
items.a: No. A question is a question. There is no sequence behind these forms, and asking one thing does not put you on a list that mails you every week.

items.q: Will he push me to buy or sell before I am ready?
items.a: No. He works with people months out from doing anything, and a fair number of those conversations end with him saying the timing is wrong. That is a normal outcome, not a failed one.

items.q: How do I reach him, and which does he prefer?
items.a: Call or text (813) 613-8822, or email alex@athomewichita.com. Text is usually the fastest way to get him, and he is fine handling an entire question that way if you never want to be on the phone.

items.q: What does it cost to talk to him?
items.a: Nothing. Agent commission is paid out of the transaction and it is spelled out in writing before you sign anything, so there is no bill attached to asking questions.

bands.heading: Start with a question, not a commitment
bands.body: Send Alex the thing you are actually wondering about and see what sort of answer comes back. If it is useful, you will know. If it is not, you have lost a text message.
